_comment: MCP server registry vectors. Every implementation of the registry decision (evaluateMcpRegistry in shared-types, the MCP proxy, the control plane's hook gate, @intutic/gate, intutic-clawde, and the policy snapshot's @mcp_registry record through the JavaScript and bash hook gates) runs these cases and must reach the same code, rule id and reason. The allowlist cases do the same for evaluateMcpAllowlist and the @mcp_allowlist record (not the MCP proxy, which words its own allowlist refusal). toolName is the name a harness hook sees; the server is the part before the first '__' after 'mcp__', the tool the rest. Edit the cases, never one implementation's expectations. The unverified cases hold every gate that reads the policy snapshot (the JavaScript and bash hook gates, @intutic/gate, its sandbox gate, intutic-clawde) to one answer on a snapshot that fails its integrity check: each writes the named snapshot, applies the named tamper to the file, and must refuse every MCP call with POLICY_SNAPSHOT_UNVERIFIED at block, observe-only workspaces included, while leaving a call that is not an MCP call to its other rules. Tampers: registryDenyToAllow (the registry record rewritten with defaultPolicy allow), registryUnblock (a server taken off blockedServers), registryLineDeleted, allowlistLineDeleted, allowlistWidened (a server added to the allowlist), allowlistShadowed (the allowlist's severity set to shadow), digestLineDeleted (the #digest line removed and a server added to the allowlist).

cases.reason: MCP server "pastebin" is blocked in this workspace's MCP server registry. An owner or admin can change that on the MCP Servers page.

cases.name: a held server is refused under allow
cases.reason: MCP server "drifted" changed its tools in a way scored high risk, and this workspace holds such a server until it is approved again. It is waiting in the approval queue on the MCP Servers page for an owner or admin.
